entries.title: A card says where its work came from
entries.body: The line under a card's title now quotes the message that started the work, even when the card belongs to a later part, a retry or a follow-up. It never quotes a merge click or a message you sent to several tasks. Work an automation filed says which automation ran it, and work filed from a card says what you chose and what you wrote. When your words sit on another task, the line says how many tasks away.

picture.alt: A card whose line under the title reads Run by an automation and names the Nightly product audit

entries.title: Cards explain your project's own terms and say what a change does
entries.body: When a card uses a name your project's code or people made up, it explains it in a few plain words or uses plain words instead. A card about a change says near its start whether people using your project will notice it, or whether it only changes how the project is built, checked or documented.
entries.noPicture: This changes the words your first mate and crew write on cards, not a view or control.
